items.title: Micron stock heats up again, crossing $1,000
items.summary: Micron shares are back with some momentum.

items.title: What Quadrupled Intel Stock Was Not Foundry Customers
items.summary: Demand for its server chips runs ahead of what Intel can make, and the price now carries a build-out that is still years from finished.

items.title: Tiger Global Just Swapped Big Tech for This Chip Stock. Should You Follow?
items.summary: Chase Coleman's Tiger Global just dumped Nvidia and Alphabet to load up on AMD, a move that either signals a major shift in AI investing logic or a costly bet on a stock already priced for perfection.

items.title: Nvidia Strikes Deal With OpenAI As Tenant; Is Nvidia A Buy Now?
items.summary: Nvidia stock is in a base headed into earnings next week. Shares are above an early buy point of 224.76.

items.title: AMD at $514, PLTR at $174: Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: AMD and Palantir both anchor the AI trade, but one stock sits in a constructive setup heading into 2027 while the other carries a valuation that has already priced in two years of flawless execution.

items.title: Broadcom Has Taken a Haircut Over 3 Months: One Analyst Expects 72% Returns From Here
items.summary: Broadcom has quietly slipped while the rest of the AI chip complex surged, leaving it as the only major name trading at a steep discount to analyst consensus. The question now is whether that gap closes upward or the bears finally find their footing.

items.title: Billionaire David Tepper Trimmed Micron and Sold out of SanDisk. Here’s the New AI Stocks He’s Buying
items.summary: David Tepper just posted a 32% return in six months riding memory chips, then quietly dumped his winners and moved the money somewhere most AI investors are completely ignoring.

items.title: Stocks to Watch: Alibaba, L3Harris, Diana Shipping, BHP
items.summary: ↗️ Alibaba (BABA, HK:9988): The Chinese company struck a $1.5 billion deal to sell its videogame business as it sharpens its focus on AI. Shares rose in Hong Kong; its U.S.-listed ADRs ticked up premarket.
